tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a Precleared receipt by its id (cc_rcpt_...) to show what was checked, when, and the verdict, with the hashes, Ed25519 signature and public key needed to verify it. Use it when a person or an audit asks for proof of a check.

tools.name: suppress_contact
tools.description: Records that a person asked not to be emailed, on this Precleared key's opt-out list, so every agent and tool using the key gets blocked for that address from contact_check. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "contact_check" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contact_check, suppress_contact · Private data: contact_check, suppress_contact · Public sink: contact_check, suppress_contact · Destructive: suppress_contact, link_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contact_check, suppress_contact · Private data: contact_check, suppress_contact · Public sink: contact_check, suppress_contact · Destructive: suppress_contact, link_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "contact_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
